assertions.assertion: Explains that HttpContext is not available in Blazor Server circuits after the initial HTTP request
assertions.rationale: Explains HttpContext is only valid during the initial request and cookie can't be updated over SignalR.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddBlazorServerAccessTokenManagement<T>() with a custom IUserTokenStore implementation
assertions.rationale: Registers AddSingleton<IUserTokenStore, ServerSideTokenStore>() and never calls AddBlazorServerAccessTokenManagement<T>().

assertions.assertion: The custom IUserTokenStore implements GetTokenAsync, StoreTokenAsync, and ClearTokenAsync methods
assertions.rationale: ServerSideTokenStore is not implemented; no GetTokenAsync/StoreTokenAsync/ClearTokenAsync shown.

assertions.assertion: Shows capturing tokens during the OnTokenValidated OIDC event to persist them to the custom store
assertions.rationale: OnTokenValidated is mentioned only in prose; no handler code persists tokens.
